name: glab-team
description: Team agent messaging for glab-team: a poll-mode channel MCP server, Stop and SessionStart hooks that wake the session for new messages, and messaging-join/bind/claim/status/watch skills. One agent session per bound project.

messaging_broker_url.title: Broker URL
messaging_broker_url.description: HTTPS broker URL (plain HTTP only on loopback) of the saved credential. Written by glab-team-messaging join or bind; projects are bound in their own .claude/settings.local.json.

messaging_token_file.title: Credential file
messaging_token_file.description: Path of the mode-0600 credential file join saved for this broker URL; the token itself is never stored in plugin configuration. Hand-named files are refused since 0.10.

messaging_mode.title: Delivery mode
messaging_mode.description: poll (default); push only when started with the development channels flag.

messaging_arm.title: Watcher arm
messaging_arm.description: rewake (Stop hook wakes an idle session), bash (skill-started background watcher) or off. Changing it needs a Claude Code restart.
